description: This file defines the TimesheetActionLogModel class, which is a data model used for representing timesheet action logs within the OrangeHRM system. It implements normalizable serialization and uses traits for common model features. The class is primarily responsible for mapping entity data to an API schema, including attributes such as id, action details, comments, date, and performed employee information.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing and normalizing timesheet action log data for API responses within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.description: Initializes the model with a TimesheetActionLog entity and sets up attribute filters and names for serialization.
